text:
zoe.docs: Heads-up  I'm opening a tiny PR to tidy function/tool-calling + structured-output examples. Goals: two canonical examples (invoice + intent), add a lightweight schema-pointer envelope for small clients, short guardrails on fallback parsing, and fix two broken anchors under parsing patterns. Opening in ~30m.

kai.eng: Solid. Which snippets do we need to change? I can update node + python.

zoe.docs: Plan:
- Move canonical schemas to /docs/schemas/{invoice,intents}.json
- Show full-envelope and a "schema_pointer" compact example (point to central schema file)
- Guardrails: validate -> partial-parse -> fallback-to-text, and a note about union/nullable gotchas
- Add a one-file consumer-test snippet for CI to validate outputs

mira.devex: I'll convert SDK snippets to the new structured_output param shape. Example compact envelope I'm planning:
```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"lookup_invoice","arguments":{"id":"INV-404"}},"structured_output":{"schema_pointer":"/docs/schemas/invoice.json"}}
```

ryan-qa: Please add a tiny CLI check for reviewers: `make docs-lint && ./tools/parse_validator --schema docs/schemas/invoice.json --prompts examples/invoice_prompts.txt`. I'll run the harness and paste observed outputs.

kai.eng: Note: runtime collapses single-item arrays unless `minItems:1` and trims trailing zeros on floats. I'll run sample prompts and post any diffs so docs match observed outputs.

zoe.docs: Great, put "observed vs expected" bullets in the PR if anything diverges. docs-bot: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4720 by zoe.docs

mira.devex: Assigned @kai.eng and @ryan-qa as reviewers. I'll push updated TS + Python snippets after the first commit.

zoe.docs: Targeting merge by Thu EOD if CI/lint pass. If anyone wants a piece, call it out here and I'll split the PR.
